description: Extracts one article from a public news or blog page: headline (og:title or h1), author, published and modified times, description and the article body as Markdown. Reads the page you name only; paywalled text is not returned and body text depends on the page using <article> or <main>. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

url.description: Full http or https address of an article page
